description: Defines the IMedia interface and a template class Media implementing IMedia, including nested Handler class for source handling, with methods for media control and data transfer.

classes.name: IMedia
classes.description: Interface for media operations including remote ID, open, close, reset, write, and read.

classes.name: Media
classes.description: Template class implementing IMedia, managing media channels, data transfer, and synchronization.

classes.name: Media::Handler
classes.description: Nested class inheriting from SOURCE, managing state change notifications and data transmission.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the media channel.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the media channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the media channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the media channel, aborting ongoing operations if necessary.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the media channel within a specified duration.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the media channel within a specified duration.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Returns the source handler for the media.
